summary: Verified both bug fixes in /app/frontend/app/draw/[id].tsx. (1) Pen-only mode toggle: `tool-pen-mode` button is present in the bottom toolbar, tapping it flips the label between 'Touch on' (palmRejection=false) and 'Pen only' (palmRejection=true) with no console errors; the Pan gesture handler still short-circuits when palmRejection && pointerType==='touch' in both onBegin (line 416-419) and onUpdate (line 434-436). (2) Zoom centering: tx and ty are now derived (not state) from `(pageDims.w/2)*(1-scale)` and `(pageDims.h/2)*(1-scale)` (lines 193-194); a repo-wide grep confirms `setTx`/`setTy` no longer exist; `resetZoom()` only calls `setScale(1)` (lines 620-622); the Skia <Group transform> and the `toWorld` helper consume the same derived tx/ty. Visual pinch-zoom can NOT be exercised in the web preview (the Skia canvas is replaced by the 'Stylus / S Pen canvas' fallback) so the centered-zoom behaviour must be confirmed on a native build (Expo Go / iOS / Android). Regression checks pass: navigation FAB → tpl-drawing (Handwriting / S Pen) → hw-prep modal → hw-create opens /draw/<uuid> cleanly; Chrome-style tabs row with back-arrow, tab and kebab renders at the top of both draw and note screens; tablet 1024x1366 inline sidebar renders; kebab → Page color / Page template / Page size / Rename / Undo / Redo / Clear / Trash all open and the Page color sub-menu shows the swatch grid.
action_items: Bug fix #2 (zoom-out drifting to the left) was verified by static analysis only because the web preview falls back to a non-Skia 'Stylus / S Pen canvas' view. Please run the app in Expo Go on a real device / emulator and pinch-zoom in/out a few times to confirm the canvas now stays centered on the screen at every scale and that the reset-zoom pill restores 1.0 cleanly. No other action items.
critical_code_review_comments: draw/[id].tsx is ~1800 lines — consider splitting subcomponents (DrawMenuRow, ToolBtn, Divider, ShapeOption, PaperOption, PaperFrame, PaperBackground, applyAlpha, labelForTool) into separate modules to keep the file <700 lines.
Unused subcomponents `PaperOption` and `PaperFrame` (and helper `Divider` outside this file's scope) are still defined — safe to remove if no longer referenced.

Derived tx/ty are recomputed on every render — this is fine for correctness, but if pageDims or scale changes frequently you could memoize with useMemo to avoid the extra arithmetic per frame (very minor).

rca_of_issue: Bug 1 was caused by palm-rejection settings being read but no UI toggle being exposed in the handwriting toolbar — fix adds a `tool-pen-mode` ToolBtn that flips settings.palmRejection. Bug 2 was caused by zoom being applied with translateX/translateY frozen at 0 (the old setTx/setTy state was never recomputed for centering), so the pinch transform was always anchored at (0,0) — fix removes the state and derives the translation each render from `(pageDims.w/2)*(1-scale)` / `(pageDims.h/2)*(1-scale)`, anchoring the transform on the canvas center.
